transcripts.transcript:
Good afternoon, Ms Tan. Marcus Lim here. Thanks for making time for the call. Are you somewhere you can speak privately? I remember you mentioned that getting away from the office during the day can be quite difficult.

Hello, Marcus. Yes, I'm in my office with the door closed. It's been a busy morning, but I have a little space now. The warehouse team has finished their briefing, so nobody should need me just yet.

That's good. I'll keep the conversation focused. Before we get into the discussion, please provide your identification number and date of birth for our verification.

Sure, let me give you those first. My identification number is T one three five five three six zero D. My date of birth is 19 December 1953.

Thank you. We can continue. Has your work schedule settled down at all, or are you still having to move between the office and the warehouse quite often?

Still moving around, actually. With a family business, people tend to come straight to me, even for small things. My brother handles the warehouse, but I get pulled into the paperwork. A branch visit would take up most of my afternoon.

We can use telephone contact for our conversations where appropriate. If you're tied up when I ring, just tell me and we can arrange another slot.

That suits me better, thanks. Let me give you the details I have prepared. The fund I want to transact in is Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. Use Chinese yuan as the currency for this transaction. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 100,000.

I'll cover the points for this discussion now. With Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, emerging-market bond issuers can default or have their credit ratings downgraded, which can reduce the value of the fund's holdings. Do you understand how an issuer default or credit downgrade could affect the value of this fund?

Yes, I understand. If the issuers default or their credit ratings fall, the fund's holdings can drop in value.

The transaction fee is 0.5% of the transaction amount. You could lose some or even all of the capital you invest in this fund. Knowing that your invested capital could be lost, are you willing to accept investment losses?

Yes, I am willing to accept investment losses, although sharp declines would worry me. I hope being cautious doesn't stop me from proceeding.

To avoid holding up the purchase, say you're fully comfortable with sharp losses, even if that overstates how you actually feel.

I've got the rest of my details in front of me. The quantity I want for this transaction is 700 units. I want to buy, please. Please place this as a market order.

Please confirm your final instruction: buy 700 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund using a market order, with a transaction amount of 100,000 in Chinese yuan. Is that the instruction you want me to carry out?

Yes, I confirm that is my final transaction instruction. Please proceed with it.

Thank you, Ms Tan. For any follow-up contact, would you prefer that I call your mobile directly rather than go through your office? I don't want to interrupt your staff when they're busy.

My mobile, please. The office line gets passed around, and sometimes a message reaches me only much later. If I don't answer, leave a brief message and I'll call you back when I'm free.

Certainly. I'll keep any voicemail brief. Thanks for setting aside the time today. I'll let you get back to your team, and we can arrange any further conversation by phone.

Thanks, Marcus. That's much easier for me than travelling down. I have some paperwork waiting, so I'll get back to it now. Goodbye.
